definitions.explanation: The vacation period in spring between academic years, typically from late March to early April.

{春休|はるやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊園地|ゆうえんち}→遊園地：03174_yuuenchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: When spring break ends, the new school year begins.

notes:
{春休|はるやす}み is the school vacation period in spring, typically late March to early April.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese school year starts in April, so {春休|はるやす}み falls between academic years — after graduation in March and before the new term in April. It is typically about two weeks long, shorter than ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧.

RELATED VACATION WORDS:
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧: summer vacation (longest, ~40 days)
- ⟦{冬休|ふゆやす}み→冬休み：19114_fuyuyasumi⟧: winter break (~2 weeks, around New Year)
- {春休|はるやす}み: spring break (~2 weeks)
- ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧: consecutive holidays

USAGE:
Unlike summer and winter breaks, {春休|はるやす}み typically has no homework assigned, since students are transitioning between school years.
